label_source: heuristic alignment to ordered reference route
notes: Labels are provisional, not independently verified ground truth.
Reference route files must not be used as inference features.
Trip IDs must be stored as zero-padded 8-character strings.
GroupKFold prevents observations from the same trip appearing in both training and validation folds.
GroupKFold does not shuffle; random_state is retained as a project reproducibility setting, not passed to GroupKFold.
The existing trained model uses an older approximate local projection and 10 candidates per observation.
This schema describes the planned 30-candidate pipeline. Retrain models before claiming compatibility with it.
